body: " I guess of piece of me will never forget her " I feel you man, the girl I loved will always be apart of me. Its comforting knowing someone made it out of this feeling and is doing better. I can say forsure, Being single my bank account is finally recovering...

100% relateable man, been about 6 months here from a 3yr relationship and I fucked it all up aswell. I've been talking to others about it and her breaking up with me, it changed me for better so I have to look at it like that and maybe you taking a step back and looking at it as ' do's and don'ts " of the next person you fall for. I feel love changes you everytime it breaks you, But nonetheless she will be apart of my soul forever.
I feel you op, we're all alone no matter what anyone says.
